purpose: Verify student submits leave application with optional supporting document
preconditions: Student is authenticated and authorized
action_or_input: Student submits leave application with from_date, to_date, reason, and document link
expected_result: Application recorded in submitted state, available to HoD, submission notification triggered

purpose: Verify student submits leave application without supporting document
preconditions: Student is authenticated and authorized
action_or_input: Student submits leave application with no document attached
expected_result: Application accepted and recorded in submitted state without supporting document

purpose: Verify leave application submission fails when required data is missing or invalid
preconditions: Student is authenticated
action_or_input: Student submits leave with to_date before from_date or missing reason
expected_result: System reports failure and no submitted application is created

purpose: Verify HoD reviews and approves a submitted leave application
preconditions: Leave application is in submitted state and available to HoD
action_or_input: HoD submits Approve decision
expected_result: Application status updated to Approved and decision notification triggered to student

purpose: Verify HoD reviews and rejects a submitted leave application
preconditions: Leave application is in submitted state and available to HoD
action_or_input: HoD submits Reject decision
expected_result: Application status updated to Rejected and decision notification triggered to student

purpose: Verify unauthorized user attempting to decide leave application is refused
preconditions: User is not HoD of student's department
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to approve or reject leave application
expected_result: System reports failure and prior application state is unchanged

purpose: Verify student retrieves and views own leave tracking and request history
preconditions: Student has submitted leave applications
action_or_input: Student queries leave tracking view
expected_result: Current status and full history of student's leave applications are displayed

purpose: Verify empty list returned when student has no leave records
preconditions: Student has submitted zero leave applications
action_or_input: Student queries leave tracking view
expected_result: System returns an empty list without error

purpose: Verify student submits bonafide certificate request
preconditions: Student is authenticated and authorized
action_or_input: Student submits bonafide request with stated purpose
expected_result: Request recorded in submitted state and made available to Academic Administrator

purpose: Verify bonafide request submission fails when required purpose is missing
preconditions: Student is authenticated
action_or_input: Student submits bonafide request with blank purpose
expected_result: System rejects request and no bonafide record is created

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator verifies and approves bonafide request
preconditions: Bonafide request is in submitted state
action_or_input: Academic Administrator verifies request and records Approve decision
expected_result: Request status updated to Approved and certificate becomes available for download

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator verifies and rejects bonafide request
preconditions: Bonafide request is in submitted state
action_or_input: Academic Administrator records Reject decision
expected_result: Request status updated to Rejected and decision notification triggered

purpose: Verify bonafide decision fails if attempted by non-Academic Administrator
preconditions: User lacks Academic Administrator role
action_or_input: User attempts to approve or reject bonafide request
expected_result: Decision refused and bonafide request state remains unchanged

purpose: Verify student downloads approved bonafide certificate
preconditions: Bonafide request is in Approved state
action_or_input: Student requests certificate download
expected_result: Approved certificate metadata/download is provided to the student

purpose: Verify student download is refused when bonafide request is not approved
preconditions: Bonafide request is in Submitted or Rejected state
action_or_input: Student attempts to download bonafide certificate
expected_result: Action is refused and no certificate is provided

purpose: Verify student tracks bonafide request status
preconditions: Student has submitted bonafide requests
action_or_input: Student queries bonafide status
expected_result: Current status and details of bonafide requests are displayed

purpose: Verify empty result when student has no bonafide requests
preconditions: Student has zero bonafide requests
action_or_input: Student queries bonafide status
expected_result: System returns empty list without error

purpose: Verify student initiates no-dues clearance routing to seven authorities
preconditions: Student is authenticated and has no open no-dues case
action_or_input: Student initiates no-dues clearance
expected_result: Active no-dues case created with parallel routing to all 7 mandatory clearance authorities

purpose: Verify student cannot initiate a second no-dues case while one is already open
preconditions: Student already has an active in-progress no-dues case
action_or_input: Student attempts to initiate another no-dues clearance
expected_result: System refuses duplicate initiation and existing case remains active

purpose: Verify clearance authority records Clear verification result for its domain
preconditions: Active no-dues case exists; authority is authenticated
action_or_input: Authority records Clear result for its domain
expected_result: Domain clearance is recorded as Clear; other domains remain unchanged

purpose: Verify clearance authority records Dues Outstanding verification result for its domain
preconditions: Active no-dues case exists; authority is authenticated
action_or_input: Authority records Dues Outstanding result for its domain
expected_result: Domain clearance is recorded as Outstanding; case reflects dues outstanding condition

purpose: Verify authority cannot record clearance for a domain it is not authorized for
preconditions: Librarian is authenticated
action_or_input: Librarian attempts to record clearance for Hostel domain
expected_result: Action is refused and Hostel domain result is not modified

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator finalizes no-dues clearance when all 7 domains are Clear
preconditions: All seven authorities have recorded Clear
action_or_input: Academic Administrator finalizes the no-dues case
expected_result: No-dues case transitions to Finalized and certificate becomes downloadable

purpose: Verify finalization is refused while any domain remains outstanding or pending
preconditions: At least one domain has result Outstanding or Pending
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts to finalize no-dues case
expected_result: Finalization is refused and case remains unfinalized

purpose: Verify non-Academic Administrator cannot finalize no-dues case
preconditions: All 7 domains are Clear; user is a student or department administrator
action_or_input: User attempts to finalize the no-dues case
expected_result: Action is refused with authorization error

purpose: Verify student tracks no-dues clearance progress across all 7 domains
preconditions: Student has an active no-dues case
action_or_input: Student retrieves no-dues progress
expected_result: Status of each of the seven authorities and overall progress are displayed

purpose: Verify tracking view returns empty/none when student has no active no-dues case
preconditions: Student has never initiated no-dues clearance
action_or_input: Student queries no-dues progress
expected_result: System indicates no active no-dues case exists

purpose: Verify student downloads finalized no-dues certificate
preconditions: No-dues case is Finalized
action_or_input: Student requests no-dues certificate download
expected_result: Finalized certificate metadata/download is provided to student

purpose: Verify student download refused when no-dues case is not finalized
preconditions: No-dues case is in progress
action_or_input: Student attempts to download certificate
expected_result: Download refused and no certificate is provided

purpose: Verify PG student submits assistantship claim with assigned supervisors
preconditions: Student is PG and has assigned Thesis and TA supervisors
action_or_input: PG student submits assistantship claim
expected_result: Claim created in submitted state and routed to both supervisors

purpose: Verify claim submission refused if student lacks assigned supervisor
preconditions: PG student has no active thesis supervisor assignment
action_or_input: PG student attempts to submit assistantship claim
expected_result: Submission is refused and no claim is created

purpose: Verify assigned supervisor records verification for their role on claim
preconditions: Claim is submitted and assigned to faculty member as Thesis Supervisor
action_or_input: Thesis Supervisor records verification for thesis role
expected_result: Supervisor verification is recorded for thesis role

purpose: Verify same faculty member holding both roles records both verifications distinctly
preconditions: Faculty member is assigned as both Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor
action_or_input: Faculty member records thesis verification, then records TA verification
expected_result: Both role-verifications are recorded and distinct

purpose: Verify faculty not assigned to claim cannot record verification
preconditions: Faculty member is not the assigned supervisor for the claim
action_or_input: Faculty member attempts to verify claim
expected_result: Verification action is refused

purpose: Verify Department Administrator reviews and forwards dual-verified claim to HoD
preconditions: Claim has both Thesis and TA supervisor verifications recorded
action_or_input: Department Administrator reviews claim and executes Forward to HoD
expected_result: Claim status updated to Forwarded to HoD

purpose: Verify Department Administrator cannot forward claim if supervisor verifications are incomplete
preconditions: Claim has only 1 supervisor verification recorded
action_or_input: Department Administrator attempts to forward claim to HoD
expected_result: Forwarding is refused and claim remains awaiting supervisor verification

purpose: Verify HoD reviews and approves forwarded assistantship claim
preconditions: Claim has been forwarded to HoD
action_or_input: HoD submits Approve decision
expected_result: Claim status transitions to Approved and is routed to Academic Administrator

purpose: Verify HoD reviews and rejects forwarded assistantship claim
preconditions: Claim has been forwarded to HoD
action_or_input: HoD submits Reject decision
expected_result: Claim status transitions to Rejected

purpose: Verify non-HoD cannot approve or reject forwarded assistantship claim
preconditions: User lacks HoD role for the claimant's department
action_or_input: User attempts to approve or reject the claim
expected_result: Action refused with authorization error

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator processes stipend disbursement for HoD-approved claim
preconditions: Assistantship claim is in Approved state
action_or_input: Academic Administrator processes stipend disbursement
expected_result: Claim stipend is recorded as processed and status is updated

purpose: Verify stipend processing refused for unapproved assistantship claim
preconditions: Claim is in submitted or rejected state
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts to process stipend
expected_result: Action is refused and stipend is not processed

purpose: Verify PG student tracks assistantship claim status across stages
preconditions: PG student has submitted an assistantship claim
action_or_input: PG student retrieves claim tracking view
expected_result: Current stage and verification history are displayed

purpose: Verify empty result when student has no assistantship claims
preconditions: PG student has never submitted an assistantship claim
action_or_input: PG student queries claim tracking
expected_result: System returns empty list without error

purpose: Verify Department Administrator records thesis-supervisor assignment
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Record thesis-supervisor assignment associating student with supervisor
expected_result: Thesis supervisor assignment is recorded and active

purpose: Verify new thesis supervisor assignment supersedes prior active assignment
preconditions: Student already has an active thesis supervisor assignment
action_or_input: Department Administrator records a new thesis supervisor assignment for student
expected_result: Prior assignment is superseded and new assignment becomes current

purpose: Verify recording thesis supervisor assignment fails if user is not Department Administrator
preconditions: User lacks Department Administrator role
action_or_input: User attempts to record thesis supervisor assignment
expected_result: Action refused with authorization error

purpose: Verify Department Administrator records TA assignment with course/subject only
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Record TA assignment associating PG student with course code and no supervisor
expected_result: TA assignment successfully created with course association

purpose: Verify Department Administrator records TA assignment with faculty member only
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Record TA assignment associating PG student with faculty supervisor and no course
expected_result: TA assignment successfully created with faculty association

purpose: Verify Department Administrator records TA assignment with both course and faculty
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Record TA assignment associating PG student with both course and faculty member
expected_result: TA assignment successfully created with both associations

purpose: Verify TA assignment fails if neither course nor faculty is provided
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Record TA assignment with blank course and blank faculty
expected_result: System reports validation error and no TA assignment is created

purpose: Verify PG student submits graduate seminar scheduling request
preconditions: Student is authenticated and holds PG status
action_or_input: PG student requests seminar scheduling
expected_result: Seminar request recorded in awaiting_scheduling state and available to Department Administrator

purpose: Verify non-PG student cannot submit seminar scheduling request
preconditions: Student has UG status
action_or_input: UG student attempts to submit seminar scheduling request
expected_result: Request refused and no seminar request created

purpose: Verify Department Administrator schedules graduate seminar
preconditions: Seminar request exists in awaiting_scheduling state
action_or_input: Department Administrator enters scheduled_for datetime and venue
expected_result: Seminar schedule recorded, status updated to Scheduled, and scheduling event logged

purpose: Verify seminar scheduling fails when venue or datetime is missing
preconditions: Seminar request exists in awaiting_scheduling state
action_or_input: Department Administrator attempts to schedule seminar without venue
expected_result: System reports error and seminar is not scheduled

purpose: Verify PG students and faculty view scheduled graduate seminars
preconditions: Scheduled graduate seminars exist
action_or_input: PG student or faculty member retrieves seminar schedule list
expected_result: System displays list of scheduled seminars with date, time, and venue

purpose: Verify empty schedule list returned when no seminars are scheduled
preconditions: Zero graduate seminars are scheduled
action_or_input: User queries seminar schedule list
expected_result: System returns empty list without error

purpose: Verify event notification dispatches both system alert and email
preconditions: An OAP lifecycle event triggers a notification
action_or_input: Notification dispatch process executes
expected_result: Recipient receives system alert and email notifications

purpose: Verify notification failure is handled gracefully and logged
preconditions: Email dispatch encounters transport error
action_or_input: Notification task attempts email delivery
expected_result: Failure is recorded in notification status and error is logged without failing the aggregate action

purpose: Verify pending-action reminder is issued when reminder condition is met
preconditions: Pending OAP action exceeds configured reminder threshold
action_or_input: Reminder evaluation runs
expected_result: Reminder is dispatched to responsible actor

purpose: Verify reminder is silent when no action meets reminder threshold
preconditions: All actions are recent (threshold not exceeded) or no actions pending
action_or_input: Reminder evaluation runs
expected_result: No reminder notification is generated
